title: Developer set-up (Laragon)
summary: A small accessibility fix, and a new set-up for the development team.

changed: The development team now runs the intranet on their own computers with Laragon, with realistic fake demo data for testing.
accessibility: Page-number controls that you cannot use at the moment are now announced properly by screen readers.

internal_notes: Laragon is the only supported local set-up. Demo data loads with the demo seed command and refuses to run outside local development.
